grades: Entering grade 7 or higher in the fall of the next school year
name: Teen Volunteer
org: WonderLab Museum of Science, Health, and Technology
what_you_do: Teens share their enthusiasm with museum visitors. The page lists no birthday party or outreach roles.
who_can_apply: Teens entering at least 7th grade in the fall of the next school year. Teens apply with the Teen Volunteer Application; adults 18 and over use a separate form.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Perks: free admission, 20 percent off in the gift store
deadline_text: Submit the Teen Volunteer Application (linked on the Become a Volunteer page), then register for a volunteer orientation. Orientation sessions were listed through Tuesday, November 10, 2026 (prior registration required). The page does not say applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
how_to_apply: Submit the Teen Volunteer Application (online form linked on the Become a Volunteer page), then register for a volunteer orientation. Contact: Volunteer Manager, 812-337-1337 ext. 221.
notes: Middle and high school volunteers work alongside college students and adults. Some roles (parties, outreach) need prior museum experience and training. Outreach events require your own transportation.
